# The Message REST API — Complete AI / LLM Technical Reference

> Full technical reference for LLMs, autonomous AI agents, Custom GPTs, and LangChain OpenAPI toolkits.
> Host URL: https://bakarimustafa.com
> Public Interactive Explorer: https://bakarimustafa.com/api-docs/
> OpenAPI 3.0 Spec: https://bakarimustafa.com/api/openapi.json

## JSON Response Schemas

### 1. GET /api/stats
Returns database overview metrics.

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "total_sermons": 577,
    "available_languages": 72,
    "sermons_with_pdf": 572,
    "sermons_with_audio": 525,
    "sermons_with_text": 572
  }
}
```

### 2. GET /api/messages?language=en
Returns list of sermon records.

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "count": 577,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "64-0112",
      "title": "Shalom",
      "date": "1964-01-12",
      "year": "1964",
      "language": "en",
      "pdf_url": "https://branham.org/.../64-0112%20Shalom%20VGR.pdf",
      "m4a_url": "https://branham.org/.../64-0112%20Shalom.m4a",
      "cover_image": "https://branham.org/azure/branham/073884ef-dd28-41d1-a7b8-33accbc478b2.jpg",
      "location": "Phoenix, AZ",
      "series": "easter-messages",
      "length": "medium"
    }
  ]
}
```

### 3. GET /api/messages/{id}/text?language=en
Returns full sermon transcript broken into numbered paragraph blocks with sentence-level tagging and editor's notes tags.

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "64-0112",
    "title": "Shalom",
    "language": "en",
    "paragraphs": [
      {
        "number": 1,
        "text": "SHALOM... Thank you, very much, Brother Isaacson...",
        "sentences": [
          { "id": "p1-s1", "text": "SHALOM... Thank you, very much, Brother Isaacson.", "is_editor_note": false }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### 4. GET /api/series
Returns 16 official sermon series (Adoption, Hebrews, Seventy Weeks, Seven Seals, Church Ages, etc.).

```json
{
  "total_series": 16,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "seven-seals",
      "slug": "seven-seals",
      "title": "The Revelation of the Seven Seals",
      "year": 1963,
      "sermon_count": 8,
      "sermons": ["63-0317M", "63-0317E", "63-0318", "63-0319", "63-0320", "63-0321", "63-0322", "63-0324M", "63-0324E"]
    }
  ]
}
```

### 5. GET /api/places
Returns preaching locations with sermon counts.

```json
{
  "total_places": 170,
  "data": [
    { "place": "Jeffersonville, IN", "sermon_count": 526 },
    { "place": "Chicago, IL", "sermon_count": 67 }
  ]
}
```

## OpenAPI 3.0 JSON Definition

AI agents can directly consume the OpenAPI spec at `https://bakarimustafa.com/api/openapi.json`.
